description: Permanently delete a workspace Brain document, its stored file and the Brain knowledge derived from it. This cannot be undone. Requires workspace settings permission. Retry-safe with the same idempotency_key.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_delete_brain_document
title: Delete Brain Document
